title: Multi-agent pipeline on a shared blackboard
description: Eleven agents — Spec Validation, Analyst, Architect, Planner, Coder, Subagent, Tester, Reviewer, DevOps, Triage and the security scanners — driven by an incremental orchestrator. All state lives in one file per run, so a run can be stopped and resumed in a different process.

title: Plan approval bound to a hash of the plan
description: Planning stops and waits for a person. The approval is bound to a fingerprint covering the file plan and the milestone partition, so a build refuses to start when the plan has changed since it was read.

title: Agent tooling — seven agents can read the project
description: Read a file, list a directory, search the code, and Anthropic's server-side web search. Bounded at six lookups and three rounds per run, with every path checked to stay inside the project. Verified against the live model.

title: Coder write–test–fix loop
description: The Coder writes files, runs the project's own test suite, reads the failure and corrects it inside one stage. Writing is confined to the approved file plan; run_tests takes no command. Verified live on a failing suite.

title: Edit a plan in the browser
description: Drop files from a plan or add them, from the plan review page. Editing clears the approval and sends the plan back to be read again. Refuses while a build is in flight, on a stale page, or when it would leave an empty plan.

title: Refuse a plan naming a file that does not exist
description: Each file plan entry carries a create or modify action. A modify against a path that is not in the repository is rejected, re-asked once with the offending paths named, then refuses the run rather than building something that changes nothing.

title: Three ways in — spec, issue, question
description: Build something new from a specification, change an existing repository from an issue or a written request, or ask a question about a repository and get a written report back.

title: Browser interface — dashboard, plan review, run detail
description: Run list and portfolio view, a submission form, a plan review page with inline answers and approval, a run detail page showing gates and findings, and a log tail. Bound to localhost.

title: Repo Map — multi-language symbol index and content search
description: Indexes symbols across Python, Kotlin, Swift, Java, JavaScript and markup, and searches file contents. Keeps prompts bounded on large repositories by selecting only the files relevant to a request.

title: Anchored edits instead of file replacement
description: Search and replace against an anchor that must match exactly once, so a change alters a span rather than rewriting a file. Includes a guard that refuses a write which would delete most of an existing file.

title: Review gate with per-requirement coverage
description: The Reviewer checks every requirement one at a time and returns a coverage table. A requirement reported as not delivered blocks approval automatically, rather than being left to the model's own verdict. An objection can be cleared by a named person.

title: Security and compliance gates
description: A linter-style scanner for secrets and unsafe patterns, plus ten compliance checks scoped by data tier. Findings need a named person and a reason to clear.

title: Milestones, subagents and the integrator
description: Splits a large specification into milestones with one component each, merges the output, runs the tests and retries only the component that failed. The Planner's partition is validated rather than trusted.

title: Budget guard and control plane
description: A soft cap that compacts context and a hard cap that checkpoints and stops, plus pause, kill and resume at stage boundaries. Builds run as detached processes with their command, pid and log recorded.

title: Report generation as HTML and PDF
description: Produces written reports from the factory's own state, rendered to HTML and printed to PDF with headless Chrome. A missing browser is not an error — the HTML is the document.

title: Semantic layer and closed feedback loop
description: A YAML model generating types, interfaces, data tiers and invariant tests. Plus a feedback loop that clusters user reports, triages them, applies a risk gate and routes anything uncertain to a person.

title: Let the Coder run a linter and a build behind an allowlist
description: run_tests deliberately takes no command, so the Coder cannot run a linter, a build or a compiler. A compile error in a language the tests do not cover still reaches a person. Widening this needs an allowlist design and a decision on whether to do it at all.

title: Run a milestone build against the live API
description: Splitting a large specification across several passes is covered by tests with fake responses only. It is the largest untested surface in the factory, and the Subagent gained tool access without that path being exercised live.

title: Verify mobile builds — Android emulator and a macOS runner
description: The factory reads and writes Kotlin and Swift but cannot verify either. Android tests need a device or emulator in the build image; iOS needs macOS, which is infrastructure rather than code.
